description: XSUAA security descriptor for the NorthForge AP Exception Triage service

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.AP.Clerk
scopes.description: Can view exceptions and take approve/reject/edit actions within threshold

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.AP.Supervisor
scopes.description: Can additionally approve high-value invoices, escalate, and trigger re-triage

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.AP.Auditor
scopes.description: Read-only access to invoice exceptions and the recommendation audit trail; cannot approve, reject, edit, or trigger re-triage

role-templates.name: AP_Clerk
role-templates.description: AP Clerk — processes routine invoice exceptions

role-templates.name: AP_Supervisor
role-templates.description: AP Supervisor — handles escalations and high-value approvals

role-templates.name: AP_Auditor
role-templates.description: AP Auditor — internal audit / SOX-compliance read-only reviewer

role-collections.name: AP.Clerk
role-collections.description: Role collection assigned to AP clerks in SAP BTP Cockpit / Identity Authentication

role-collections.name: AP.Supervisor
role-collections.description: Role collection assigned to AP supervisors in SAP BTP Cockpit / Identity Authentication

role-collections.name: AP.Auditor
role-collections.description: Role collection assigned to internal auditors / SOX compliance reviewers in SAP BTP Cockpit / Identity Authentication
